verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents an API-based integration alongside its SDKs and publishes an OpenAPI spec. Specific actions like refunds are explicitly available through both the API and the Dashboard, and a community developer praises full API integration at the terminal level. However, nothing states general UI/API parity, and reader management (order, register, configure, monitor) is described only as a Dashboard feature in the evidence. missing for 10: an explicit statement or demonstration that every Dashboard action (reader ordering/configuration/monitoring, fleet management) has an API equivalent, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
You can issue refunds by using the Refunds API or the Dashboard.
This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe's API.
the ability to fully integrate with the API on a terminal level is the most powerful thing here
